title: opencli
brief: Turns any website into a CLI an AI agent can use: opencli drives your logged-in browser session (Playwright-based) so agents can operate sites through a command line instead of fragile DOM scripting. ~30k stars.
details: OpenCLI (github.com/jackwener/opencli) turns any website into a CLI and lets AI agents drive your logged-in browser. It ships built-in adapters for sites like Bilibili, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Reddit, HackerNews, Twitter/X and LinkedIn, plus an opencli-browser skill (installable via npx skills add) so agents in Claude Code or Cursor can navigate, click, fill forms and extract data through your real Chrome session via a lightweight Browser Bridge extension. You can also author new adapters end-to-end with the opencli-adapter-author skill. Roughly 30k stars, Apache-2.0 licensed, with a desktop app bundling the runtime for macOS and Windows.
